pages.text: Taro found a stone in the stream. A hole went right through its middle. Through the hole, the sky looked round.
"I'll show Mumu!" Taro ran to the well tree. Mumu had promised to come there, too.
The well tree was very thick. Four grown-ups holding hands could barely reach around it. From one side, you could not see the other at all.
Taro stood on this side. "Mumu isn't here yet."
Mumu stood on the other side, stretching their neck to look down the road.
Taro went around the tree. Mumu went around it, too. They both went in the same direction.
Round and round and round. Footprints made a circle around the tree. Still, they could not see each other.
Mumu looked at the ground. More footprints stretched ahead. "Oh? Those aren't mine!"
Mumu turned the other way. Bonk! Their foreheads bumped together.
They both landed on their bottoms. The stone had rolled away. Still sitting, Mumu looked through its hole. "Taro is round!"
